name: MRCB
recent: MRCB 于 2025 年 9 月 8 日签署协议，以 15.79 亿令吉现金收购 Bukit Jalil Sentral Property 80% 股权及一批 A 类可赎回优先股，卖方为 EPF 旗下公司，属关联方交易。最新季度（2026 年 6 月 30 日止）营收环比下降 45.3%，但净利环比大增 314.5%。
notable: MRCB 旗下间接全资子公司 Rukun Juang 拟以 15.79 亿令吉现金，向 EPF 旗下 Tanjung Wibawa 收购 Bukit Jalil Sentral Property 80% 股权及 11.33 亿股 A 类可赎回优先股。
risks: 上述收购属关联方交易，卖方为 EPF 旗下公司，需留意相关审批及利益冲突披露。

recent_en: On 8 September 2025, MRCB signed an agreement to acquire 80% of Bukit Jalil Sentral Property and a tranche of Class A redeemable preference shares for RM1.579 billion cash from an EPF subsidiary, a related party transaction. In the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue fell 45.3% QoQ while net profit jumped 314.5% QoQ.
notable_en: MRCB's indirect wholly-owned subsidiary Rukun Juang proposes to acquire 80% of Bukit Jalil Sentral Property and 1.133 billion Class A redeemable preference shares from EPF's Tanjung Wibawa for RM1.579 billion cash.
risks_en: The acquisition is a related party transaction with an EPF subsidiary as vendor; approvals and conflict-of-interest disclosures should be noted.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM174.5 million, down 45.3% QoQ and 41.4% YoY; net profit was RM14.5 million, up 314.5% QoQ but down 3.8% YoY; net margin was 8.3% versus 1.1% in the prior quarter.
